title: SR-4.02 A licence server that issues and activates licences
request: Closes G37: No licence server exists; memev license activate has nothing to call. Repository: mgillr/memev-cloud. Depends on contracts: SR-4.01, SR-9.03.

tasks.title: Activation endpoint
requirements: POST /v1/activate takes a key, returns a signed licence; stores no vault data; rate limited; keys hashed at rest
the signing key lives in an HSM or KMS, never in the repo

criteria.statement: A valid key returns a licence that memev verifies offline; a reused key is refused past its seats
No vault-derived field is accepted or stored
